tei:titleStmt.tei:title: 'um̐ḥklong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥyum bka' mtsho rgyal bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa ba'i sgrub pa bde chen dpal phreng bzhugs soḥ
'um̐ḥklong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥyum bka' mtsho rgyal bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa ba'i sgrub pa bde chen dpal phreng bzhugs soḥ

tei:div.tei:p: "!#'um̐ḥ klong chen snying gi thig le lasaḥ yum bka' mtsho rgyal bde chen rgyal mo'i rtsa ba'i sgrub pa bde chen dpal phreng bzhugs soḥ
mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mor 'dudaḥ

dkyil 'khor zla gam sgo gcig dbusaḥ chos 'byung dmar po lha mtshan canaḥ de steng bde skyong ma da naḥ yang na rin chen sman bcud gtamasaḥ shel dang me long srog gi rtenaḥ phyi nang mchod pas mtha' nas bskoraḥ nub kyi phyogs su kha bstan laḥ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba niḥ
na moḥ skye med ye shes mkha' 'gro'i skuḥ 'gag med rang byung rnal 'byor maḥ rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo laḥ 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchiḥ
lan gsum gnyis pa smon 'jug semasaḥ
hoḥ 'di nas byang chub ma thob b.raḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro khyod bsgrubs nasaḥ phyogs ris bral ba'i sems can rnamasaḥ bde chen sa la 'god par bgyiḥ
lan gsum gsum pa mchod gtor brlabaḥ
oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ dngos por 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog kunaḥ phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprinaḥ kun tu bzang po'i 'dod yon niḥ nam mkha' lta bur 'dzad pa medaḥ sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ
bzhi pa bskyed rim a ti bsgomaḥ

aḥ snang ba thams cad yum lnga'i klongaḥ srid pa thams cad mkha' 'gro'i dalaḥ rgyu rkyen las 'das gzhal yas khangaḥ thig le nyag gcig chos dbyings sgoḥ bde chen 'bar ba'i pho brang dbusaḥ chu skyes ge sar bzhad pa'i stengaḥ nyi ma'i gdan la mkha' 'gro'i gtsoḥ chos sku'i klong na kun bzang moḥ longs sku'i zhing na wā ra hiḥ sprul sku ye shes mtsho rgyal maḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dmaraḥ gcer mo mnyam pa'i dor stabs canaḥ shin tu chags dang bzhad pa'i zhalaḥ phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te 'uḥ snyan gyi thad kar gtod cing 'khrolaḥ g.yon pa gri gug yu ba niḥ dku la brten nas mchog tu 'gyingaḥ bha ga rgyas shing nu ma 'buraḥ rin po che dang gzhon nu'i rgyanaḥ puṇ+ḍa ri ka'i do shal 'phyangaḥ rus pa'i rgyan drug sku la gsolaḥ gnag snum dbu skra'i lan tshar canaḥ rin po che yi rtse bran brjidaḥ dbu ma'i spyan ni dbyings
gyen/
la gzigasaḥ longs sku'i spyan gyis
g.yon thad ka/
'gro ba 'dulaḥ sprul sku'i spyan gyis
g.yas 'og/

khams gsum 'gugasaḥ sku la rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor rdzogasaḥ thugs ka dpal gyi be 'u'i dbyingasaḥ ma bskyed rang byung yongs grub lhaḥ 'khor lo rtsibs lnga'i lte ba ruḥ kun gzhi yid chos gnas dag pa'iḥ khyab gdal rig pa kun tu bzangaḥ snang stong gnyis med yum dang sbyoraḥ rtsibs lngar gzugs tshor 'du shes dngaḥ 'du byed rnam shes dag pa'i lhaḥ rnam snang rin 'byung snang mtha' dngaḥ don grub rdo rje mi bskyod paraḥ sa chu spyan dang mā ma kīḥ me rlung gos dkar dam tshig sgrolaḥ nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug lngaraḥ gnas dag rigs kyi yum lngas 'khrilaḥ g.yas phyogs dbang po'i rtsa bzhi laḥ rnam shes dag pa'i nang sems bzhiraḥ yul bzhi dag pa'i sems mas 'khrilaḥ mig la sa snying sgeg mo maḥ rna bar phyag rdor glu ma gnyisaḥ sna la nam snying phreng ba moḥ lce la spyan ras gzigs gar maḥ g.yon phyogs dbang po'i rtsa bzhi laḥ dbang po dag pa'i phyi sems bzhiraḥ dus bzhi dag pa'i sems mas 'khrilaḥ mig la byams pa bdug spos maḥ rna bar sgrib sel me tog canaḥ sna la kun bzang ā lo keḥ lce la 'jam dpal dri chab maḥ dpral ba lce dang snying ga dngaḥ lte ba gsang gnas rkang mthil g.yonaḥ 'jig rten drug dang nyon mongs lngaḥ ser snar lta ba gnas dag pa'iḥ rig pa'i skyes bu thub pa drugaḥ yan lag bzhi la sems can gyiḥ lus kyi rnam par shes pa dngaḥ dbang po reg bya reg shes bzhiḥ

gnas dag sgo ba yab bzhi laḥ rtag chad lta dang bdag lta dngaḥ mtshan mar lta ba gnas dag yumaḥ lag g.yas gshin rje lcags kyu maḥ g.yon par stobs chen zhags pa moḥ rkang g.yon rta mgrin lcags sgrog maḥ g.yas par bdud rtsi 'khyil dril buḥ tshad med bzhi yi phrin las canaḥ dag bya dag byed rdzogs pa lasaḥ yongs grub gdan gsum tshang ba'i lhaḥ snang la rang bzhin med par gsalaḥ de yi ba spu'i bu ga laḥ khrag 'thung rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor niḥ ma lus lus pa med par rdzogasaḥ kun kyang sku mdog phyag mtshan dngaḥ rnam 'gyur ma nges sgyu 'phrul niḥ rang byung rang shar chen po 'oḥ 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gros bskoraḥ rigs bdag pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ a tsar+ya gzhon dkar gsal 'dzumaḥ he ru ka pa cang dril 'khrolaḥ dam tshig ye shes gnyis su medaḥ bsgoms pa tsam gyis dngos grub thobaḥ
sa ma yaḥ lnga pa spyan 'dren gdung ba'i blosaḥ

hūm̐ḥ yul gyi ming ni rgya gar yulaḥ gnas kyi mchog gyur u rgyan gnasaḥ dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i grongaḥ gling gi gling mchog rnga yab glingaḥ don la 'og min bde chen zhingaḥ rnam pa mkha' spyod sprul pa'i gnasaḥ dgyes shing bzhugs pa'i yul kun nasaḥ chos sku yum chen mtsho rgyal maḥ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i 'khor dang bcasaḥ byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob laḥ sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skuraḥ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad solaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥ
drug pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal baḥ
hoḥ gdod nas dam tshig ye shes paḥ gnyis su med pa rdo rje'i stanaḥ mkha' 'gro sems kyi cho 'phrul duḥ lhan cig skyes la phyag 'tshal loḥ na mo na maḥhūm̐ḥ
bdun pa 'dod yon mchod pa 'bulaḥ
hoḥ snang zhing srid pa'i chos so cogaḥ 'dod yon lnga yi rgyan du sharaḥ sems kyi yid bzhin gter chen poḥ blang dor med pa'i dgyes mchod 'bulaḥ badz+ra dz+nyā na ḍā ki nī puṣ+pe
nasaḥ
shab+da ma hā mu drā rak+ta pū dza ba liṃ ta sarba pū dza aḥhūm̐ḥ
brgyad pa bstod cing smon lam gdabaḥ

hūm̐ḥ rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ sna tshogs yum gyur shes rab pha rol phyinaḥ rjes chags bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur mtsho rgyal yumaḥ sangs rgyas pad+ma'i lcam la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ mthong bas yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i lang tsho canaḥ thos pas rnam grol 'gag med brda yi gsungaḥ dran pas bde stong ye shes skyed pa'i thugasaḥ ḍā ki'i rje mo mkhar chen bza' la bstodaḥ bcu drug dga' ster mchog gi pho nya mo'iḥ gsal snang sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin dang 'grogs pasaḥ phyi nang gzhan gsum rtsa rlung thig le'i khamasaḥ kun tu bzang mo'i klong du dag gyur cigaḥ
'di ltar sgrub pa'i dzap dgongs niḥ

rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ruḥ phag mo mthing nag gri thod canaḥ snying dbus dga' 'khyil baṃ mtshan mtharaḥ sngags phreng 'khor ba'i 'od zer gyisaḥ lha sku'i snang zhen gsal bar byasaḥ rigs bdag bla ma'i thugs rgyud bskulaḥ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byasaḥ bla ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyunaḥ zag med bde ba chen por babasaḥ dga' ba bzhi yi byed las kyisaḥ dbang bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myongaḥ oṃ pad+mo yo gi nī dz+nyā na wā ra hi hūm̐ḥ
zhes rtsa sngags dang lus dkyil la dmigs nasaḥ
oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ḥ

rgyal thabs spyi blugs tshangs pa'i dbangaḥ bskur thob med pa'i chos nyid laḥ mnyam par bzhag pa gnad kyi gzeraḥ bskyed rdzogs rnams grangs mang mi dgosaḥ 'di nyid gcig pus dngos grub thobaḥ sa ma yaḥ rtags kyi rim pa bsam yas kyangaḥ mchog la dgongs pa g.yo 'gul medaḥ thun mong mkha' 'gro 'du ba dngaḥ ji snyed mkhyen pa'i klong rdol bsaḥ snang ba brda dang chos skur 'charaḥ nyams dga' bag phebs rig pa dwangasaḥ mkha' spyod grub sogs yon tan brgyadaḥ dngos su grub cing rmi lam duḥ bud med dmar mo 'du ba dngaḥ me tog dung 'gron shel dkar rnyedaḥ mda' dang phyag mtshan mthong ba sogasaḥ mkha' 'gro 'grub pa'i rtags su bshadaḥ phrin las kha bsgyur gzhan du shesaḥ sa ma yaḥ rjes kyi rim pa'i tshogs skong niḥ bsod nams nang nas tshogs 'khor mchogaḥ mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dam tshig rdzasaḥ nang mchod khyad par bzang du bshamaḥ
hoḥ bde ba chen po'i snod mchog tuḥ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i longs spyod niḥ blang dor med pa'i dam tshig rdzasaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir gyuraḥ
tshogs phud rim pa gsum du sprosaḥ

hūm̐ḥ 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhingaḥ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnasaḥ nyi shu rtsa bzhi sprul pa'i yulaḥ nang ltar rdo rje phung po'i grongaḥ spyi bo dzā lan+dha ra dngaḥ smin mtshams pul+li ra ma laḥ ltag pa'i rtsa khams arbu taḥ mdzod spu rā me shwa ra dngaḥ rna ba g.yas pa o rgyan yulaḥ g.yon pa go dha ba ri'i zhingaḥ mig gnyis de bī ko ṭa dngaḥ phrag pa ma la wa brgyad naḥ bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor maḥ mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro maḥ tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsolaḥ dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldemaḥ lcang lo'i zar bu ta la laḥ snyan cha gdu bu kyi li liḥ rus rgyan g.yer kha khro lo loḥ cang te'u dril bu'i sgra dang bcasaḥ rdo rje'i glu dang gar la rolaḥ 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs su 'bulaḥ dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ phyi nang bar gcod dbyings su sgrolaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ ༈ longs spyod 'khor lo lam pā kaḥ mchan dang mkhal khung kā ma rūḥ nu ma gnyis ni o ḍi steḥ lte ba tri sha ku na'i grongaḥ sna yi rtse mo ko sa laḥ ya rkan ka liṅga yi yulaḥ snying ga kāñtsi ka dang niḥ hi mā la yi grong khyer naḥ bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor maḥ mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro maḥ tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsolaḥ dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldemaḥ lcang lo'i zar bu ta la laḥ snyan cha gdu bu kyi li liḥ

rus rgyan g.yer kha khro lo loḥ cang te'u dril bu'i sgra dang bcasaḥ rdo rje'i glu dang gar la rolaḥ 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs su 'bulaḥ dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ phyi nang bar gcod dbyings su sgrolaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ ༈ mtshan ma pre ta pu ri'i zhingaḥ bshang lam gṛ ha de ba'i yulaḥ mthe bong ma ru brla raṣ+ṭaḥ byin pa su bār+ṇa dwī paḥ sor mo bcu drug na ga raḥ pus mo ku lu ta dang niḥ bol gong sin+dhu'i grong khyer naḥ bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo rnal 'byor maḥ mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro maḥ tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsolaḥ dbu skra thor tshugs ldems se ldemaḥ lcang lo'i zar bu ta la laḥ snyan cha gdu bu kyi li liḥ rus rgyan g.yer kha khro lo loḥ cang te'u dril bu'i sgra dang bcasaḥ rdo rje'i glu dang gar la rolaḥ 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs su 'bulaḥ dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ phyi nang bar gcod dbyings su sgrolaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ
tshogs skong sbrel ma byed naḥ

hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsolaḥ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gyur pasaḥ lus ngag sems kyis sdig spyad mthol zhing bshagasaḥ theg pa dman pa'i dbang du gyur pas naḥ yang dag don ma rtogs pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ snying rje chung zhing zhe sdang dbang gyur pasaḥ 'gro ba'i don ma bgyis pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ le lo gnyid kyi dbang du gyur pa yisaḥ sgom dang sgrub pa g.yel ba mthol zhing bshagasaḥ ser sna 'jur gegs dbang du gyur pas naḥ mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa mthol zhing bshagasaḥ nga rgyal khengs sems dbang du gyur pas naḥ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba bshagasaḥ brtse gdung chung ba'i dbang du gyur pas naḥ grogs mched thugs dang 'gal pa mthol zhing bshagasaḥ zla grogs ngan pa'i dbang du gyur pas naḥ phud dang lhag mar gyur pa mthol zhing bshagasaḥ phud dang lhag ma nyams pa'i skyon dbang gisaḥ phud nyul thugs dang 'gal pa mthol zhing bshagasaḥ phud nyul thugs dang 'gal pa'i skyon dbang gisaḥ mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad gnas gyur mthol lo bshagasaḥ sgrol ba'i dus na snying rje chung ba yisaḥ sems can gnas ma stobs pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ nyon mongs gnas ma stobs pa'i skyon dbang gisaḥ yid kyi sgrib par gyur pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ sbyor ba'i dus su ting 'dzin ma gsal bsaḥ gzungs ma'i thugs dang 'gal pa bzod par gsolaḥ gzungs ma'i thugs dang 'gal pa'i skyon dbang gisaḥ
chags shing 'khor bar skyes pa mthol lo bshagasaḥ bshags nas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsolaḥ
ces snying thag pa nas bshags pas dam tshig nyams chag sor chud par 'gyur roḥ de nas lhag ma ni kha phrus btab laḥ

oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hāḥ phaiṃḥ lhag la dbang ba'i bka' nyan niḥ mkha' 'gro sum cu rtsa gnyis dngaḥ ging chen khyo shug laṅka 'bumaḥ pho nya sum brgya drug cu'i sdeḥ mgyogs ma bzhi dang 'bar ma brgyadaḥ ma mo bdun dang sring mo bzhiḥ shugs 'gro gnas nyul phra men rnamasaḥ lhag la gdung zhing tshogs khang 'grimaḥ pham phab bzang po 'di bzhes laḥ mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad solaḥ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzodaḥ
ces phyi rol du doraḥ thugs dam bskul ba niḥ

hūm̐ḥ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i lhaḥ chos kyi dbyings nas bskur bzhengs laḥ byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad thulaḥ snod bcud 'byung ba'i rgud pa solaḥ rtsa rlung dbang thang nyams pa gsosaḥ sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaḥ
chad tho bya ba niḥ

hūm̐ḥ dus gsum las 'das kun tu bzangaḥ rang bzhin rnam dag 'og min duḥ gdan gsum tshang ba'i ston 'khor gyisaḥ gsang chen rdo rje'i chos 'khor bskoraḥ dngos 'dzin dag pa'i lha gnas gsumaḥ rgyud sde 'byung ba'i gnas su bstanaḥ sngags ni las can sprul pa'i ngoraḥ rang bzhin nyid du 'byung ba'i tsheḥ sgrags mda' mtsho rgyal bla mtsho ruḥ dpal chen rang byung rdo rje'i rgyudaḥ gnas gsum mkha' 'gros byin brlabs shingaḥ sred len med pa'i brda yig lasaḥ 'dzad med gter gyi sgo phye tsheḥ 'khrul pa gzhi la dag pa yiḥ rten 'brel bzhin du phrin las mdzodaḥ
brtan ma skyong ba niḥ
hūm̐ḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan bod khams skyongaḥ ma sring brtan ma bcu gnyis rnamasaḥ 'dir byon gtor ma'i bshal chu bzhesaḥ bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzodaḥ
rta bro bya ba niḥ
hūm̐ḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor 'diraḥ log par 'dren pa'i dam sri kunaḥ mnan no theg pa rim dgu'i rgyaḥ nam yang ldang bar ma gyur cigaḥ s+t+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ
de nas mchod cing bstod laḥ dngos grub blang ba niḥ

hoḥ mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i dam tshig da nangs themasaḥ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la da babs naḥ mi gnas ye shes thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ sku gsung thugs dang mnyam sbyor dbang bcu'i stobasaḥ da lta nyid du bdag la bstsal du gsolaḥ oṃ pad+mo yo gi nī dz+nyā na wā ra hi badz+ra kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ
sgrub rdzas gnas gsum gtugs shing myangaḥ nongs pa bshags pa niḥ
hūm̐ḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor duḥ mchod rdzas ma tshang sgrub pa g.yelaḥ ting 'dzin bying rmugs 'thibs la sogasaḥ 'gal 'khrul nongs pa bzod par gsolaḥ oṃ badz+ra satwa
sogs brjodaḥ rdzogs rim niḥ
hoḥ chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhinaḥ rang las sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ ye shes dbyings su badz+ra muḥ rjes thob sgyu ma'i lha skur ldangaḥ
bsngo ba niḥ
hoḥ mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor duḥ bskyed rdzogs bzlas brjod bgyis pa yiḥ dge ba'i rtsa ba gang bsags paḥ 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngoḥ
smon lam niḥ
hoḥ snang srid thams cad dag pa mkha' spyod zhingaḥ bde chen 'gyur med rdo rje rnal 'byor maḥ rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi phag mo dngaḥ rang zhal mjal te mngon par byang chub shogaḥ
bkra shis niḥ

hoḥ rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin rlabs dngaḥ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dngaḥ gsang sngags zab mo'i rten 'brel gyisaḥ 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i bkra shis shogaḥ tshe bsod rgyas pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ snang ba dbang 'dus bkra shis shogaḥ log 'dren tshar gcod bkra shis shogaḥ snang zhen lha sku'i phyag rgyar rdzogasaḥ sgrar grags bde chen sngags su dgaḥ dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur sminaḥ 'ja' lus zang thal bkra shis shogaḥ
gzhan yang bkra shis gang rgyas bya'oḥ
sa ma yaḥ gter rgyaḥ brda rgyaḥ zab rgyaḥ

rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pas sgrags mda' mtsho rgyal bla mtshor mkha' 'gro rang byung rgyal mo'i thugs ka nas/ dpal len pa med pa'i mkha' 'gro'i brda ris spyan drangs pa las bsgyur ba slad nas chog khrigs su bsdebs pa'o/// /
